root_cause.text: In the RDS subsystem, the `rds_message_purge()` function incorrectly infers zerocopy state from the socket reference (`rm->m_rs`) instead of the notifier pointer (`op_mmp_znotifier`), resulting in missed pinned page accounting when zerocopy sends fail before message queuing.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the extraction of `op_mmp_znotifier` before the `rm->m_rs` check and adds an `else if (znotifier)` block to execute `mm_unaccount_pinned_pages` when the socket reference is null but the notifier exists.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes memory leak by adding cleanup path for zerocopy notifier resources when zerocopy operation fails before socket association
intent_record.what: Added local znotifier variable extraction before clearing rm->data.op_mmp_znotifier, changed zcopy initialization to use extracted value, and added else-if block to handle zerocopy cleanup when rm->m_rs is NULL
intent_record.how: Enables proper cleanup of pinned pages and notifier memory when zerocopy fails before message queueing on socket, preventing resource leaks in error paths

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement incorrectly infers zerocopy state from the socket reference (rm->m_rs) rather than checking the notifier pointer (op_mmp_znotifier). When zerocopy sends fail before message queuing, rm->m_rs may be NULL or stale, causing missed pinned page accounting during rds_message_purge(). The fix should check op_mmp_znotifier directly to determine if zerocopy was actually used.
